newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Paraguay finance minister steps down for elections.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay finance minister steps down for elections.

text.p: Paraguayan President Juan Carlos Wasmosy said on Friday his finance minister, Carlos Facetti, had resigned to prepare his campaign for the presidency in elections in 1998.
"Facetti has presented his resignation to dedicate himself to campaigning to obtain the Colorado Party presidential candidacy for 1998 to 2003," Wasmosy told a news conference.
Facetti will continue to supervise the government's economic team, but former presidential chief of staff Miguel Maidana Zayas will become the new finance minister.
The outgoing finance minister was put on the short list for the Colorado candidacy three months ago, when Wasmosy switched his support from former Education Minister Nicanor Duarte.
He will face six competitors for the Colorado candidacy, including party chief Luis Argana and controversial former army chief Gen. Lino Oviedo.

Oviedo triggered fears of a military coup last April when he holed himself up in his barracks in defiance of Wasmosy's orders that he be discharged. He was later cleared in court of attempted rebellion.
Facetti, 59, was public works minister from 1993 until he was moved to the finance portfolio in April 1996.
